Our Mission

Helping small businesses get found

We partner with small businesses to design and build websites that turn searches into enquiries — a proper home online, not just a social page. Every build includes:

  • i.
    Mobile-first designMost of your customers are on phones — your site is designed for them first, and looks premium on every screen.
  • ii.
    WhatsApp chat buttonOne tap and a visitor is chatting with you — enquiries land straight in your WhatsApp, not a lost inbox.
  • iii.
    Maps, hours & contactYour location, opening hours, phone, email and Instagram — clear, correct and easy to find.
  • iv.
    Fast & cleanLight, quick-loading pages with your photos and colours — no clutter, no confusing menus.
  • v.
    Ready to be foundProper titles and structure so people searching for your business can actually find your website.
How It Works

From idea
to live

  1. Tell us about your businessMessage us on WhatsApp or email — your business name, what you do, and any photos or logo you have.
  2. We design your websiteWe build a premium design in your colours, with your menu, services, rooms, treatments or products.
  3. You review itSee it on your phone, tell us what to change, and we refine it until it feels like your business.
  4. We launch itYour website goes live — ready to share on Instagram, WhatsApp and Google, and ready for customers.
